rules.statement: A deed cannot be set aside as fraudulent by a creditor who becomes such after the date of the alienation, unless it be proved to have been made with an intention to defeat future creditors.
rules.supporting_quote: "This I consider exactly to express the law of this country, if we add the words 'or unless it be proved that a person who was a creditor at its date has been paid with the money of the subsequent creditor who seeks to set it aside.'"
